Privacy Policy

Last updated: May 7, 2026

What XShots does

XShots renders tweet previews and exports them as PNG images. Tweet data is fetched via the FxTwitter API — no user content is stored on any server.

Third-party services

Tweet data is fetched from the FxTwitter API so the app can render previews in your browser. XShots does not display third-party ads.

Your choices

You can stop using the app at any time or clear your browser data if you want to remove local activity.

Contact

For questions, open an issue on the GitHub repository.
